endorsements.name: Berk Dusunur
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25331
endorsements.description: Zenar Content Management System contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts by manipulating form parameters in POST requests. Attackers can inject script tags through the current_page parameter sent to the ajax.php endpoint, which reflects unsanitized user input in the response HTML to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victim browsers.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

endorsements.name: Berk Dusunur
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25365
endorsements.description: PCViewer vt1000 contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files by submitting relative path sequences in GET requests. Attackers can use path traversal sequences ../../../../../../../../../../../../etc/passwd to access sensitive system files outside the intended directory.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37057
endorsements.description: Online-Exam-System 2015 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the feedback module that allows attackers to manipulate database queries through the 'fid' parameter. Attackers can inject malicious SQL code into the 'fid' parameter to potentially extract, modify, or delete database information.
